scope: generation-scoped Linux IRQ-work publication inventory, drain and BootIrqRoute retirement
pinned_linux_fact: irq_work_sync(struct irq_work *) is declared in include/linux/irq_work.h and EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL in kernel/irq_work.c; raised_list remains private upstream and patch 0005 exports it without changing queue logic

implementation_decision.registry: private per-OS-slot generation, LIVE/STOPPING state, sender count, exact per-CPU work-node pointers and retained callback/work storage
implementation_decision.publication: acquire a generation/state sender lease before enqueue, retain ownership across notification, release after the attempt even when IPI fails
implementation_decision.retirement: atomically enter STOPPING, reject new sender leases, wait for sender count zero, call irq_work_sync on every retained work node, then clear callback/master publication and permit generation reuse
implementation_decision.queue_rule: do not attempt removal from Linux's private lockless raised_list; sender quiescence plus irq_work_sync is the reclamation primitive

required_tests: queued work and executing callback overlap
all retained per-CPU nodes synchronized before route unpublish
no generation reuse before drain and exactly-once reuse afterward
